text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — drafting the segmented welcome sequence for the new launch cohort. Want to align cadence + routing before I finalize the copy.
Jon Rivera: Nice. What's the cohort split again?
Maya Patel: 3 cohorts: "product-explorer", "integrator", "enterprise-eval". Size estimates in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheet/example (see tab 'cohorts')
Liam Chen: For product-explorer I recommend a 3-email micro-nurture over 7 days. subject A/B on email 1, compact CTAs.
Sophia Lee: Integrator should get deeper onboarding content + an invite to the 'Quickstart' webinar on day 4. Also include a short checklist PDF.
Oliver Grant: Enterprise-eval -> route to SDRs immediately on engagement > 1 link click. Can we add a webhook to push those leads to SalesQueue-Intl?
Maya Patel: Yes. Proposed routing rules in bottom of the sheet. Pseudocode for the webhook payload:

```
POST /webhook/sdr
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "cohort": "{{cohort}}",
  "engagement_score": {{score}},
  "source": "newsletter-welcome"
}
```

Jon Rivera: @Maya can you add the engagement_score calc? We should avoid false positives — maybe require 2 distinct clicks or CTA + reply.
Maya Patel: Agree. I'll set threshold = clicks >=2 OR reply_count >=1. Will add suppression window 30d after conversion.
Liam Chen: For deliverability, schedule sends staggered by timezone. Also throttle sends to new domains to avoid spikes.
Sophia Lee: Subject line ideas (short): "Welcome to Redwood — Start in 5 mins", "Get started with your first prompt", "Quick resources to try today"
Oliver Grant: I'll own the SDR mapping and tag rules. Will create the SalesQueue rules in SFDC and share.
OpsBot: Campaign job created: campaign_id=cmp_2026_042, scheduled=2026-04-02T16:00:00Z, staging-send=2026-04-01T16:00:00Z :rocket:
Jon Rivera: Need owners for copy and header designs. @Sophia take copy for integrator and enterprise? @Maya will do product-explorer.
Sophia Lee: Yep, taking copy. Will post copy drafts by EOD Tue.
Maya Patel: I'll update the sheet with final cadence + the webhook spec by Monday. Also adding subject A/B cells so we can push to the ESP testing queue.
Liam Chen: One more ask — add a small eval hook to capture NPS-like signal on email 3 (1-5 star quick link). It helps Optimize recommend models for follow-ups.
Maya Patel: Good call. I'll add a 1-click rating row and map it to engagement_score.
Oliver Grant: Once Sophia and Maya post copy, I'll run one preview batch for deliverability and send to the QA inbox.
Jon Rivera: Perfect. If no blockers, we'll go to staging send next Tue. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Thanks all — will ping when sheet updated and share mockups.
Sophia Lee: Mockups ETA Tue. If anyone wants to swap subject lines, shout now.
Liam Chen: I'll check the ESP throttles and reporting hooks after staging send.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: staging_send_checklist assigned to @Oliver Grant, @Liam Chen on 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z
